text.en:
Section one, Chapter J, item 141 of Act Numbered Three thousand and sixty is hereby amended
to read as follows:
"141. Allowance for thirty-four cadets appointed in accordance with the provisions of section eighteen,
paragraph twenty-one, of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and
thirty-five.............................................................. P19,500.00"

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 16, 1923.
